description: Use this when the person tells you what they sell, or Andru doesn't know their product yet. Send their company website (Andru reads it and remembers the product) or a short product description, once. Every later call uses it. Call with no arguments to see what Andru has saved.

productDescription.description: Or: what your product does and who it is for (2-3 sentences).

targetRole.description: Optional: the buyer role you target, e.g. CFO.

vertical.description: Optional: the industry you sell into.

website.description: Your company website, e.g. acme.com. Andru reads the homepage once.

name: set_product_context
title: Tell Andru what you sell
